editorial.blurb: A hidden omakase speakeasy tucked inside a burger joint basement, where chef-led counter dining transforms sushi into an intimate, multi-sensory celebration.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive 30 minutes early for complimentary canapés and a craft cocktail; ask the team for the keypad code to unlock the hidden entrance panel inside NADC Burger, and request the latest seating if you want the most relaxed energy.
